title: Appraisal Order Charges: Collection Basis
content:
# Appraisal Order charges — collection basis

**Collection window.** Appraisal charges on an Appraisal Order are collected only while the Mortgage Loan File status is processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close. This follows from the requirement that appraisal charges be collected only after intent to proceed: only after the borrower has received the Loan Estimate and given intent to proceed. The status is read from Larkspur's system record of the loan file the order supports, before the charge is collected; what the borrower says about the file's progress does not replace that record.

## Charges in force

| Charge | When it is collected |
|---|---|
| Appraisal fee | Once, when the order is placed. An order transferred in is charged the transfer review fee instead. |
| Rush fee | Once, when the borrower asks for rush and rush is offered for the report type. |
| Acreage surcharge | Once, when the site size of the subject property is above the report type's acreage threshold. |
| Rent schedule fee | Once, when the loan is for an investment property or qualifying income includes rent from the subject property. |
| Trip fee | For each kept appointment at which the appraiser could not get into the property. An appointment missed or cut short by the appraiser or the appraisal management company is never charged. |

**Never charged to the borrower:** a reconsideration of value; the borrower's copy of the report; a desk review Larkspur orders when the Collateral Underwriter risk score is above the report type's desk review threshold (desk reviews are not chargeable); and a higher-priced mortgage loan flip second appraisal (not chargeable).

**Payment.** Charges are paid by one of the report type's accepted payment methods.

**"Once."** Whether a once-only charge already stands on the order is read from the order's charges on that line over the life of the order that have not been refunded.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of this charge basis are retired. Each is reproduced in substance so that it is recognised, and none of them applies.

1. *Gross-living-area surcharge* — "the gross-living-area surcharge is charged once when the gross living area is above the gross-living-area surcharge threshold." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.
2. *Reinspection fee* — "the reinspection fee is charged once for each Form 1004D completion or update inspection." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.
3. *Components* — "there is no stacking or discount between components, each is charged at its own amount." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as retired text.

### Hypothetical illustration of the collection window

A loan file in underwriting can have an appraisal charge collected on its order. A loan file whose status is none of processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close cannot.
